positive.sql: SELECT DISTINCT person.name FROM person_order JOIN person ON person_order.person_id = person.id JOIN menu ON person_order.menu_id = menu.id WHERE person.gender = 'male' AND person.address IN ('Moscow', 'Samara') AND menu.pizza_name IN ('pepperoni pizza', 'mushroom pizza') ORDER BY name DESC;
